name: Food Service Specialties
old_description: In 1985, Food Service Specialties was founded in Columbus, Wisconsin by lifelong best friends Don Leick and Steve Lineer. During a visit to a potential customer, they had been asked to match and scale up a custom pizza sauce in an attempt to create uniformity and consistency in their customer’s sauce from batch to batch.
about:
Food Service Specialties was founded in 1985 in Columbus, Wisconsin, by lifelong friends Don Leick and Steve Lineer. The pair started the business after a prospective customer asked them to match and scale up a custom pizza sauce to ensure batch-to-batch consistency. The company remains family-owned, with the next generation now active in management.

The company formulates, manufactures, and packages tomato- and dairy-based sauces for foodservice, frozen-food, and retail customers. Operations moved to Red Wing, Minnesota, in 1998, where a 45,000-square-foot plant was built; a 34,000-square-foot expansion followed in 2007, bringing total production space to roughly 79,000 square feet.

Its sauces are supplied to restaurants, frozen-food manufacturers, and retail brands across the United States and internationally.

The business was built on the premise of delivering uniform, high-quality custom sauces, and it continues to emphasize safe, legal, and consistent products for every batch.
